title: Rose Garden：老街区、历史保护区与 Diridon 周边
title_en: Rose Garden: older streets, a conservation area and the Diridon edge
intro: Rose Garden 在 Downtown 西侧，东北边是 The Alameda，西边是 I-880，片区因 Naglee Ave 与 Dana Ave 路口的 Municipal Rose Garden 得名，东半部是 Shasta-Hanchett。这里以二十世纪前半叶的老独立屋为主，市政府的 Hanchett and Hester Park Conservation Area 保留了 Prairie、Spanish Revival 和 Craftsman 风格的住宅。Rose Garden Branch Library 在 Naglee Ave，Rosicrucian Egyptian Museum 在 Park Ave，往东不远就是 Diridon 站。靠近 Downtown 和轨道交通是这个市场的优势，老房维护和 SJC 航线则是常见的取舍。
intro_en: Rose Garden lies west of Downtown, with The Alameda to the northeast and I-880 to the west. It takes its name from the Municipal Rose Garden at Naglee Ave and Dana Ave, and Shasta-Hanchett forms its eastern half. Homes are mainly from the first half of the twentieth century, and the city’s Hanchett and Hester Park Conservation Area holds a strong mix of Prairie, Spanish Revival and Craftsman houses. Rose Garden Branch Library is on Naglee Ave, the Rosicrucian Egyptian Museum is on Park Ave, and Diridon Station is a short way east. Being close to Downtown and rail is the draw, while older-home upkeep and SJC flight paths are the usual trade-offs.
buyer: 老房重点看地基与抗震加固、老电线和老水管、屋顶，以及历年加建有没有许可；常见单车位或独立车库，路边停车要实地看。房子如果在 Conservation Area 内，外观改动前先向市规划部门确认要求。这一带学校主要属 San José Unified，新边界自 2027–28 学年起对新生适用，请按完整地址和入学学年向学区核实。
buyer_en: On older homes, focus on the foundation and seismic work, old wiring and pipes, the roof, and permits for past additions. One-car or detached garages are common, so see street parking for yourself. If a home is inside the Conservation Area, ask city planning what applies before changing the exterior. Schools here are mainly in San José Unified, whose new boundaries apply to incoming students from 2027–28, so confirm the full address and enrollment year with the district.
seller: 这个邮编里的老独立屋、主路沿线的公寓、Diridon 周边较新的公寓和联排，买家和定价逻辑都不同，要分开找可比成交。老房的差别常在结构更新和原有细节的保存程度，地基、电线、水管的工程记录和许可越完整越好。靠近 Diridon 的房子要预期买家询问 BART Phase II 施工，回答时以 VTA 公布的资料为准。
seller_en: Older houses, condos along the main roads, and newer condos and townhomes near Diridon draw different buyers and price differently, so find comparable sales within each group. Among older homes, the gap usually comes down to structural updates and how much original detail survives, which makes complete records and permits for foundation, wiring and plumbing work valuable. Near Diridon, expect questions about BART Phase II construction and answer them from VTA’s published information.
